featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Exceptional Experience at Modi MG Mira Road

I had an absolutely outstanding experience with Modi MG Mira Road.

I booked my vehicle on 28th January 2026 with a very strict condition that the delivery must happen on 2nd February 2026, as it was my wedding anniversary. To my pleasant surprise, the team not only committed to it but delivered the car right on time, making the day truly unforgettable.

Special thanks to Mr. Ram Pathak, Ms. Rita, and Mr. Rutvik Surve (Finance Team) — they were exceptional throughout the process. Not a single call was missed, every query was answered patiently, regular updates were shared, and there was complete transparency at every stage. The coordination and professionalism were top-notch.

The delivery experience was amazing, and the cake-cutting ceremony arranged for both the car delivery and my wedding anniversary was a very thoughtful and heartwarming gesture. It really showed the extra effort the team puts into customer happiness.

Overall, a truly seamless and memorable experience. I would highly recommend Modi MG Mira Road to anyone planning to buy an MG vehicle.

One humble suggestion — installing a fast charger at the showroom would further enhance the EV customer experience.

Great work, team Modi MG Mira Road! 👏🚗⚡

Because of him, I feel confident in my driving skills. I am very thankful to Vijay Sir for his support and guidance.

featured_reviews.name: KHUSHAL DESHMUKH
featured_reviews.review_text: I learned car driving from Vijay Kumar Shinde in an Maruti Suzuki Ertiga. featured_reviews.name: Raj Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:

The instructors are patient, professional, and explain everything clearly, which makes learning driving much easier and less stressful. They focus on both practical skills and road safety rules, which helped me gain confidence behind the wheel.

The training sessions are well-organized, and they adjust their teaching according to your learning pace. I also liked how they give useful tips for real road situations, not just for passing the test.

Overall, I would definitely recommend Prakash Shinde Driving School to anyone who wants to learn driving in a comfortable and supportive environment.

featured_reviews.name: Aashish
featured_reviews.review_text:

The training sessions were well-structured, and the instructor gave helpful tips that made learning easy and stress-free. I especially appreciated their punctuality and supportive attitude throughout the course.

I would highly recommend this motor training school to anyone looking to learn driving in a safe and comfortable environment.

featured_reviews.name: vishal kudtarkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
First Car Experience Ruined – False Promises & Huge Financial Loss

This was my first car purchase, and unfortunately, it turned into one of the worst buying experiences of my life.

I saw the car in the first week of January 2025. Since I was a first-time buyer and not fully aware of technical details, I trusted the dealer. I paid a token amount after they promised delivery within a couple of weeks and assured me that all issues like minor dents, polishing, AC work, clutch work, etc. would be fully resolved before delivery.

On the delivery day, the car was nowhere near ready. Shockingly, no work had been done at all even after taking the token. Only when I arrived in the morning did they start working on the car. I had to wait the entire day and finally got delivery at 8:30 PM, which is unacceptable.

Within one week, the engine check light came on. The car started overheating and had issues with the crankshaft sensor and timing belt. I contacted them immediately. They asked me to give the car for “2 days,” which turned into 10–12 days. I had to keep calling repeatedly with no clear response.

Even after that, the car still had issues. They assured me that since the ownership transfer was not done yet, I could use the car for 15 days and they would replace it if problems continued. After those 15 days, the situation became worse—the car barely gave 5 kmpl, despite being promised 13–15 kmpl.

When checked at another workshop, I was informed the engine had major back compression issues, with repair estimates of ₹1.3–1.5 lakh. After this, the dealer became unreachable, saying the office was closed or that they were out of town—for 1–2 months.

Left with no choice, I sold the car and suffered a loss of nearly 45% of the purchase amount within just a few months.

After this entire experience, I did some research on my own and noticed that the dealer has a workshop located on the opposite side of the road from the showroom. From what I could observe and understand, many cars appear to be worked on there—repaired, repainted, and fixed for defects—before being sold.

This explains why their pricing is slightly lower compared to other dealers. However, these cars are presented as being in excellent or “ready” condition, while in reality they seem to be heavily worked-on vehicles rather than genuinely problem-free ones.

As a customer, this lack of transparency is extremely concerning, especially for first-time buyers who trust the dealer’s word.

This was my first and last car from this dealership. I’m sharing this review so others don’t go through the same stress, time loss, and financial damage.

featured_reviews.name: Subhasish Mallick
featured_reviews.review_text:
The most unfavorable location to purchase a motorcycle.

I have come to realize that while riding on the highway, the motorcycle ceased functioning automatically just one day after I bought it. Subsequently, I made numerous requests to return the motorcycle for a reduced price, but my requests were denied. I continue to experience the same issue, where the engine stops while driving on the highway, despite having a full tank of fuel.

They merely apply paint to the exterior and sell the motorcycles. One might perceive that the condition of the motorcycle is excellent upon inspection, but in reality, it is not in good condition.

In my opinion, I would not recommend purchasing a second-hand motorcycle from this agency.

You are well aware of the date when I made my purchase from you. You are acquiring bikes directly from the owner in satisfactory condition, and subsequently, you are swapping parts from a bike in good condition to one in poor condition, and vice versa. As a result, the bike in good condition becomes compromised, as was the case with my bike. You sold me a bike with damaged components:
1. The mileage meter is not functioning correctly,
2. The fuel meter is inoperative,
3. A damaged clutch plate was installed along with the belt,
4. The horn is damaged,
5. There is no engine oil,
6. The rear wheel brake shoe is damaged.

For these reasons, I have visited his premises more than three times for servicing, but he has only addressed the fuel meter and the rear wheel brake shoe.
